surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 22 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Burooj (The Constellations) is the 85th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 22 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء ذات البروج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the sky containing great stars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the sky with its towering constellations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the promised Day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the promised Day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the Witness and that which is witnessed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Cursed were the companions of the trench
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: damned were the makers of the trench

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Containing] the fire full of fuel
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When they were sitting near it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They sat down

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to watch what they were doing to the believers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما نقموا منهم الا ان يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذي له ملك السماوات والارض ۚ والله على كل شيء شهيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنات ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الانهار ۚ ذلك الفوز الكبير
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Honorable Owner of the Throne
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Glorious Lord of the Throne

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Effecter of what He intends
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He does whatever He will

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: of Pharaoh and Thamud

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While Allah encompasses them from behind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God surrounds them all

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But this is an honored Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is truly a glorious Quran

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [written] on a preserved Tablet
